mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mcp_server ORDER BY created_at DESC,id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mcp_server(id,name,endpoint,token_ciphertext,enabled,timeout_seconds,result_limit,auth_type,auth_header) VALUES(#{id,typeHandler=com.febridge.persistence.UuidTypeHandler},#{name},#{endpoint},#{cipher},#{enabled},#{timeout},#{limit},#{authType},#{authHeader}) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET name=EXCLUDED.name,endpoint=EXCLUDED.endpoint, token_ciphertext=EXCLUDED.token_ciphertext,enabled=EXCLUDED.enabled, timeout_seconds=EXCLUDED.timeout_seconds,result_limit=EXCLUDED.result_limit,auth_type=EXCLUDED.auth_type,auth_header=EXCLUDED.auth_header
mapper.sql: SELECT t.*,s.name AS server_name,s.enabled AS server_enabled FROM mcp_tool t JOIN mcp_server s ON s.id=t.server_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mcp_tool(id,server_id,name,description,input_schema) VALUES(#{id,typeHandler=com.febridge.persistence.UuidTypeHandler}, #{serverId,typeHandler=com.febridge.persistence.UuidTypeHandler},#{name},#{description},CAST(#{schema} AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT(server_id,name) DO UPDATE SET description=EXCLUDED.description, input_schema=EXCLUDED.input_schema,discovered_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, available=TRUE,enabled=COALESCE(mcp_tool.enabled_override,TRUE)
mapper.update: UPDATE mcp_tool SET enabled_override=#{enabled},enabled=(#{enabled} AND available) WHERE id=#{id,typeHandler=com.febridge.persistence.UuidTypeHandler}
mapper.select: SELECT s.* FROM mcp_server s JOIN agent_mcp_grant g ON g.server_id=s.id WHERE g.agent_id=#{agentId,typeHandler=com.febridge.persistence.UuidTypeHandler} ORDER BY s.name,s.id
mapper.update: UPDATE tool_call_audit SET argument_fields=CAST(#{fields} AS jsonb) WHERE id=#{id,typeHandler=com.febridge.persistence.UuidTypeHandler}
